answers.ask: How big is one key relative to the player - a single platform, or a whole area you walk around on?
answers.answer: Cada tecla debe ser una plataforma gigante individual, lo bastante grande para que un jugador miniatura se mueva sobre ella y salte entre teclas.

answers.ask: Are the nine zones one continuous route across the desk, or separate stages you teleport between?
answers.answer: Las nueve zonas forman una ruta continua sobre el mismo escritorio, sin teletransportes entre etapas.

answers.ask: Does the run end at the CPU, or somewhere else on the desk?
answers.answer: El recorrido termina en la zona de la CPU, que funciona como la meta final de escape.

scene_prompt: Crea un mapa 3D de obby colorido sobre un enorme escritorio, visto a escala de personas miniatura. Una ruta continua atraviesa nueve zonas sin teletransportes: teclas normales gigantes, teclas que desaparecen, rebotan o se hunden, seguida por las zonas del mouse, monitor, cables, escritorio y CPU. Cada tecla es una plataforma individual lo bastante grande para caminar sobre ella y saltar hacia las teclas vecinas; integra láseres, ventiladores, teclas móviles, plataformas giratorias, cables eléctricos, barras de empuje, objetos que caen y zonas peligrosas a lo largo del recorrido. El trayecto termina en la zona de la CPU, presentada como la meta final de escape. Coloca monedas coleccionables sobre rutas, saltos y zonas de riesgo.
agent_notes: The prompt self-declares 'un obby moderno de Roblox' and the giant keys are platforms jumped between at the player's own pace, so Obby & Platformer with its genre-wide P6. Shape is course-flat because the intake answer says the nine zones form one continuous route across the same desk with no teleports between stages, which rules out course-tower and space-staged; the monitor and CPU zones give some vertical gain but nothing in the brief overhangs the route, so no P2 and I did not upgrade to course-terraced. Took Classic Obby and added the options the prompt states outright that the preset lacks: obstacle-timing for the disappearing and sinking keys, hazard-kill for the lasers, electrified cables and stated elimination zones, collectible-nodes for the coins, social-hub for the cosmetics shop at the start, and winner-zone at the CPU since the answers name it as the final escape goal. Without a user I judged the timer and best-time leaderboard, pets, daily rewards, achievements and XP levels to be gameplay and UI rather than layout, so they carry no option and no pipeline cost.
